why: The off-by-one on a freshly written loop bound, and the reason the grid test asserts an exact label list rather than `length <= total`. It leaks less than the entry above -- one level, not the campaign -- but it leaks something worse: the extra button is enabled, so it starts a level the player has not unlocked, and on the last one it indexes past the level system entirely. Distinct from `level-grid-draws-the-whole-campaign` because the fix is different (a bound, not a variable) and because a test that merely counted 'fewer than total' would kill that one and survive this.
killedBy: hud: level select panel renders one button per UNLOCKED level, and none at all for the rest (issue #555)
